title: Are There Too Many Farms in the World? Labor Market Transaction Costs, Machine Capacities, and Optimal Farm Size
abstract: This paper seeks to explain the U-shaped relationship between farm productivity and farm scalethe initial fall in productivity as farm size increases from its lowest levels and the continuous upward trajectory as scale increases after a threshold -observed across the world and in lowincome countries. We show that the existence of labor-market transaction costs can explain why the smallest farms are most efficient, slightly larger farms least efficient and larger farms as efficient as the smallest farms. We show that to explain the rising upper tail of the U characteristic of high-income countries requires there be economies of scale in the ability of machines to accomplish tasks at lower costs at greater operational scales. Using data from the India ICRISAT VLS panel survey we find evidence consistent with these conditions, suggesting that there are too many farms, at scales insufficient to exploit locally-available equipmentcapacity scale-economies.
abstract_zh: 本文试图解释农场生产率与农场规模之间的U形关系：随着农场规模从最小水平增加，生产率最初下降；而超过某一阈值后，随着规模继续扩大，生产率持续上升。这一关系在世界各地以及低收入国家都曾被观察到。我们表明，劳动力市场交易成本的存在可以解释为何最小的农场效率最高、略大一些的农场效率最低，而更大的农场效率又与最小的农场相当。我们还表明，要解释高收入国家U形曲线中上升的右尾部分，就必须存在机器在更大作业规模上以更低成本完成任务的规模经济。利用印度ICRISAT VLS面板调查数据，我们发现了与这些条件相一致的证据，这表明农场数量过多，其规模不足以利用当地可获得的设备产能规模经济。

Satellite Remote Sensing for Developing Time and Space Resolved Estimates of Ambient Particulate in Cleveland, OH
abstract: This article empirically demonstrates the use of fine resolution satellite-based aerosol optical depth (AOD) to develop time and space resolved estimates of ambient particulate matter (PM) ≤2.5 µm and ≤10 µm in aerodynamic diameters (PM(2.5) and PM(10), respectively). AOD was computed at three different spatial resolutions, i.e., 2 km (means 2 km × 2 km area at nadir), 5 km, and 10 km, by using the data from MODerate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS), aboard the Terra and Aqua satellites. Multiresolution AOD from MODIS (AOD(MODIS)) was compared with the in situ measurements of AOD by NASA's AErosol RObotic NETwork (AERONET) sunphotometer (AOD(AERONET)) at Bondville, IL, to demonstrate the advantages of the fine resolution AOD(MODIS) over the 10-km AOD(MODIS), especially for air quality prediction. An instrumental regression that corrects AOD(MODIS) for meteorological conditions was used for developing a PM predictive model. The 2-km AOD(MODIS) aggregated within 0.025° and 15-min intervals shows the best association with the in situ measurements of AOD(AERONET). The 2-km AOD(MODIS) seems more promising to estimate time and space resolved estimates of ambient PM than the 10-km AOD(MODIS), because of better location precision and a significantly greater number of data points across geographic space and time. Utilizing the collocated AOD(MODIS) and PM data in Cleveland, OH, a regression model was developed for predicting PM for all AOD(MODIS) data points. Our analysis suggests that the slope of the 2-km AOD(MODIS) (instrumented on meteorological conditions) is close to unity with the PM monitored on the ground. These results should be interpreted with caution, because the slope of AOD(MODIS) ranges from 0.52 to 1.72 in the site-specific models. In the cross validation of the overall model, the root mean square error (RMSE) of PM(10) was smaller (2.04 µg/m(3) in overall model) than that of PM(2.5) (2.5 µg/m(3)). The predicted PM in the AOD(MODIS) data (∼2.34 million data points) was utilized to develop a systematic grid of daily PM at 5-km spatial resolution with the aid of spatiotemporal Kriging.
abstract_zh: 本文通过实证方式展示了如何利用高分辨率的卫星气溶胶光学厚度（AOD）数据，来构建环境颗粒物（PM）的时空高分辨率估计，这些颗粒物的空气动力学直径≤2.5 µm和≤10 µm，分别记为PM(2.5)和PM(10)。我们利用搭载于Terra和Aqua卫星上的中分辨率成像光谱仪（MODIS）数据，以三种不同的空间分辨率计算AOD，即2 km（天底处代表2 km × 2 km的区域）、5 km和10 km。为证明高分辨率AOD(MODIS)相对于10 km AOD(MODIS)的优势，尤其是在空气质量预测方面，我们将多分辨率的MODIS AOD与NASA气溶胶机器人网络（AERONET）太阳光度计在伊利诺伊州Bondville进行的AOD现场测量进行了比较。我们采用了一种工具回归方法，对AOD(MODIS)进行气象条件校正，并以此建立PM预测模型。在0.025°和15分钟的时间间隔内聚合的2 km AOD(MODIS)，与AOD(AERONET)的现场测量表现出最佳关联。与10 km AOD(MODIS)相比，2 km AOD(MODIS)更有希望用于估计环境PM的时空高分辨率数据，因为它具有更好的位置精度，并且在地理空间和时间上拥有显著更多的数据点。利用俄亥俄州克利夫兰市并置的AOD(MODIS)与PM数据，我们建立了回归模型，用于预测所有AOD(MODIS)数据点对应的PM。我们的分析表明，经气象条件校正后的2 km AOD(MODIS)斜率与地面监测的PM接近于1。不过，这些结果应谨慎解读，因为在特定站点的模型中，AOD(MODIS)的斜率介于0.52至1.72之间。在整体模型的交叉验证中，PM(10)的均方根误差（RMSE）（整体模型中为2.04 µg/m³）小于PM(2.5)的（2.5 µg/m³）。我们利用约234万个预测的PM数据点（来自AOD(MODIS)数据），借助时空克里金法（spatiotemporal Kriging），构建了5 km空间分辨率的系统性每日PM网格。

Air Quality Interventions and Spatial Dynamics of Air Pollution in Delhi and its Surroundings
venue: International Journal of Environment and Waste Management 4(1/2): 85-111
abstract: The paper examines the spatial distribution of air pollution in response to recent air quality regulations in Delhi, India. Air pollution was monitored at 113 sites spread across Delhi and its surrounding areas from July-December 2003. From the analysis of these data three important findings emerge. First, air pollution levels in Delhi and its surroundings were significantly higher than that recommended by the World Health Organization (WHO). Second, air quality regulations in the city adversely affected the air quality of the areas surrounding Delhi. Third, industries and trucks were identified as the major contributors of both fine and coarse particles.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了印度德里近期空气质量法规实施后，空气污染的空间分布变化。2003年7月至12月，我们在德里及其周边地区的113个站点监测了空气污染情况。通过对这些数据的分析，得出三点重要发现。第一，德里及其周边地区的空气污染水平显著高于世界卫生组织（WHO）的建议值。第二，该市的空气质量法规对周边地区的空气质量产生了不利影响。第三，工业和卡车被确定为细颗粒物和粗颗粒物的主要来源。

Economic Growth and the Rise of Forests
abstract: Although forests have diminished globally over the past 400 years, forest cover has increased in some areas, including India in the last two decades. Aggregate time-series evidence on forest growth rates and income growth across countries and within India and a newly-assembled data set that combines national household survey data, census data and satellite images of land use in rural India at the village level over a 29-year period are used to explore the hypothesis that increases in the demand for forest products associated with income and population growth lead to forest growth. The evidence is consistent with this hypothesis, which also shows that neither the expansion of agricultural productivity nor rising wages in India increased local forest cover.
abstract_zh: 尽管过去400年间全球森林面积有所减少，但在一些地区，包括过去二十年的印度，森林覆盖面积有所增加。本文利用跨国和印度国内森林增长率与收入增长的汇总时间序列证据，以及一个新构建的数据集（该数据集结合了全国家庭调查数据、人口普查数据，以及29年间印度农村村庄层面的土地利用卫星影像），来检验以下假说：与收入和人口增长相伴随的森林产品需求增加，会导致森林增长。证据与这一假说相一致。此外，研究还表明，无论是农业生产率的扩张还是印度工资的上涨，均未增加当地的森林覆盖面积。

Dynamic Savings Decisions in Agricultural Environments with Incomplete Markets
venue: Journal of Business and Economic Statistics 15(2): 282-292
abstract: We develop a methodology for examining savings behavior in rural areas of developing countries that explicitly incorporates the sequential decision process in agriculture. The approach is used to examine the relative importance of alternative forms of savings in the presence and absence of formal financial intermediaries. Our results, based on stage-specific panel data from Pakistan, provide evidence that the presence of financial intermediaries importantly influences the use of formal savings and transfers for income smoothing. We also find that there are significant biases in evaluations of the savings-income relationship that are inattentive to the within-year dynamics of agricultural production.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种方法，用于考察发展中国家农村地区的储蓄行为，该方法明确纳入了农业中的序贯决策过程。我们运用该方法，考察在存在和不存在正规金融中介的情况下，各种储蓄形式的相对重要性。基于巴基斯坦分阶段面板数据的结果表明，金融中介的存在对正规储蓄的使用以及用于平滑收入的转移支付具有重要影响。我们还发现，若忽视农业生产的年内动态变化，对储蓄与收入关系的评估会存在显著偏误。

title: The Dynamics of Agricultural Production and the Calorie-Income Relationship: Evidence from Pakistan
abstract: Panel data on farm households from rural Pakistan are used to estimate the calorie response to different components of income in an analysis that takes into account the sequential nature of agricultural production, labor and capital market imperfections, heterogeneity, and productivity effects of calories. The estimates indicate that the income-calorie relationship depends importantly on production stage, the form of income, the liquidity of assets, and the extent to which income is anticipated. The planting-stage wage-calorie elasticity is 0.61, but income increases in the food-abundant harvest stage have only small effects on calorie consumption confined to households with below-average wealth.
abstract_zh: 本文利用巴基斯坦农村农户的面板数据，估计了卡路里摄入量对不同收入构成部分的反应。分析考虑了农业生产的序贯性、劳动力与资本市场的不完善、异质性，以及卡路里的生产率效应。估计结果表明，收入与卡路里之间的关系在很大程度上取决于生产阶段、收入形式、资产的流动性，以及收入被预期的程度。播种阶段的工资与卡路里弹性为0.61，而在食物充足的收获阶段，收入增加对卡路里消费的影响很小，且仅局限于财富低于平均水平的家庭。

title: Comparative Advantage, Information and the Allocation of Workers to Tasks: Evidence from an Agricultural Labor Market
abstract: We use data from an agricultural labour market in which workers receive both time- and piece-rate wages and shift frequently among employers and tasks, to assess the roles of comparative advantage, information problems and preferences in determining the allocation of workers. The estimates which impose minimal structure not implied by economic theory are consistent with a one-factor productivity model, and indicate that information asymmetries are present but workers are sorted according to comparative advantage. In particular, the disproportionate presence of female workers in weeding activities is due not to worker or employer preferences but to comparative advantage and statistical discrimination.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个农业劳动力市场的数据，在该市场中，工人同时领取计时工资和计件工资，并频繁地在雇主和任务之间流动，以评估比较优势、信息问题和偏好在决定工人配置中的作用。这些估计施加的结构最少，仅采用经济理论所隐含的假设，与单因素生产率模型相一致，表明信息不对称确实存在，但工人是依据比较优势进行分类的。特别地，女性工人在除草工作中占比过高，并非源于工人或雇主的偏好，而是源于比较优势和统计性歧视。

title: Technical Change and Human Capital Returns and Investments: Evidence from the Green Revolution
abstract: Panel and time-series data describing the green-revolution period in India are used to assess the effects of exogenous technical change on the returns to schooling, the effects of schooling on the profitability of technical change, and the effects of technical change and school availability on household schooling investment. The results indicate that the returns to (primary) schooling increased during a period of rapid technical progress, particularly in areas with the highest growth rates. Such increases induced private investment in schooling, net of changes in wealth, wages, and the availability of schools, and school expansion importantly increased levels of schooling. Copyright 1996 by American Economic Association.
abstract_zh: 本文利用印度绿色革命时期的面板数据和时间序列数据，评估外生技术变革对教育回报的影响、教育对技术变革获利能力的影响，以及技术变革与学校可得性对家庭教育投资的影响。结果表明，在技术快速进步时期，（初等）教育的回报有所提高，在增长率最高的地区尤为明显。这种增长在扣除财富、工资和学校可得性的变化之后，仍然诱发了私人的教育投资，且学校规模的扩大也显著提高了受教育水平。版权所有 1996，美国经济学会。

title: Learning by Doing and Learning from Others: Human Capital and Technical Change in Agriculture
abstract: University of PennsylvaniaHousehold-level panel data from a nationally representative sample of rural Indian households describing the adoption and profitability of high-yielding seed varieties (HYVs) associated with the Green Revolution are used to test the implications of a model incorporating learning-by-doing and learning spillovers. The estimates indicate that: (i) imperfect knowledge about the management of the new seeds was a significant barrier to adoption; (ii) this barrier diminished as farmer experience with the new technologies increased; (iii) own experience and neighbors ' experience with HYV significantly increased HYV profitability; (iv) farmers do not fully incorporate the village returns to learning in making adoption decisions 1 I.
abstract_zh: 宾夕法尼亚大学。本文利用印度具有全国代表性的农村家庭面板数据，描述了与绿色革命相关的高产种子品种（HYV）的采用情况及其获利能力，用以检验一个包含“干中学”和学习溢出效应的模型的含义。估计结果表明：(i) 对新种子管理的不完全认识，是采用的重要障碍；(ii) 随着农民使用新技术的经验增加，这一障碍有所减弱；(iii) 自身经验以及邻居对高产种子的经验，显著提高了高产种子的获利能力；(iv) 农民在做出采用决策时，并未充分考虑村庄层面的学习回报。
